summary: Alphabet Inc. filed a preliminary prospectus supplement on Form 424B5 for a $15 billion public offering of Class A common stock (GOOGL) and Class C capital stock (GOOG), with joint book-running managers Goldman Sachs, J.P. Morgan, and Morgan Stanley. Concurrently, Alphabet is offering $15 billion of mandatory convertible preferred stock (Series A and B depositary shares). The filing includes an over-allotment option for underwriters, exercisable for 30 days. This capital raise is structured to finance share repurchases or other corporate purposes. The offering has no predetermined price per share or premium, and the closing is expected on or about June 5, 2026. Watch for pricing and potential dilution impact on GOOGL/GOOG shares.
